editedExercise.name: Brisk Walking Intervals

instructions.description: Walk easily to establish a comfortable rhythm.
Increase your pace for the planned interval. Walk briskly while keeping an upright posture, relaxed shoulders, and natural, coordinated arm movement.
Slow down to a comfortable pace for recovery. Relax your body and allow your breathing to settle.
Repeat the brisk and recovery intervals for the desired number of rounds, adjusting the pace and duration as needed.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Comfortable-Pace Walking provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Brisk Walking Intervals.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Alternate faster and easier walking at individually manageable intensities.
Actively swing your arms back and forth to support your walking rhythm and pace.
